name: Agamaggan's Agility
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.offerRewardText:
May your aim be unerring, and the mark of your weapon be true, friend.

Agamaggan's spirit is with you. Return <snort> to me if you wish. Mangletooth will bless you again if the great boar god deems me worthy. <snort>
narrative.requestItemsText:
My tribes greatest scouts are said to be unrivaled in their accuracy, and no rogue <snort> could measure up to their quickness in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will make you even more agile than any quilboar born.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 20 to 21, 2,900 XP in all.

quests.name: Tribes at War
quests.objectiveText: Kill 6 Bristleback Water Seekers, 12 Bristleback Thornweavers and 12 Bristleback Geomancers and return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

quests.name: Blood Shards of Agamaggan
quests.objectiveText: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens. Collect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.
